options.title: Answer options
options.description: Between 2 and 6 options. They are shown as A, B, C, ... in this order.

correctIndex.title: Correct option
correctIndex.description: Zero-based index into the options list (0 = A, 1 = B, ...).

speedBonus.title: Speed bonus
speedBonus.description: Correct answers earn up to 50% extra, scaled by how quickly they were given within the time limit (none without a time limit).
